BackstoryDef.title: Terris youth
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among the Terris people in the mountains. The Terris taught knowledge preservation and peaceful ways, but [PAWN_pronoun] also learned the fierce determination that lay beneath their gentle exterior.

BackstoryDef.title: Sliver of Infinity
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] held the power of a god at the Well of Ascension. [PAWN_pronoun] moved the planet, raised the ashmounts, and remade the world in [PAWN_possessive] image. A thousand years of absolute rule followed. [PAWN_pronoun] is both Mistborn and Full Feruchemist, functionally immortal through Compounding.

BackstoryDef.title: Survivor of Hathsin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] survived the Pits of Hathsin, a death sentence from which none had returned. The horrors of the Pits broke something within [PAWN_objective], and in that breaking, [PAWN_pronoun] Snapped. [PAWN_pronoun] emerged a Mistborn, driven by an unyielding hatred of the Lord Ruler and a dream of revolution.

BackstoryDef.title: Skaa laborer's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born to skaa workers in the Final Empire. Life was hard labor under the ash, but [PAWN_pronoun] learned to survive and to hide [PAWN_possessive] true thoughts from the nobles.

BackstoryDef.title: Noble scion
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in the keeps of the Final Empire's nobility. [PAWN_pronoun] learned politics, etiquette, and the subtle art of House intrigue from an early age.
